private_beta_readiness.summary: SHS can enter private beta after a focused operator rehearsal, route smoke pass, runbook pass, and explicit local-persistence/auth constraints are documented.

paid_client_launch_readiness.summary: Paid client launch is blocked by production-grade access/persistence decisions, acceptance/signoff workflow, Website Studio generation completion, and report delivery policy.

steps.notes: Sales lead cards and sample data exist; production intake source is not wired.
Pipeline, proposals, revenue snapshot, and handoff queue exist.
Create Production Handoff persists local handoff and sets active handoff context.
Handoffs can become production project records; admin review surfaces also exist.
Development Library generates packet text from active context; no signed/exportable delivery artifact yet.
Checklist, readiness score, blockers, and Delivery Ready state exist.
Delivery Ready exists, but final launch acceptance/signoff and deployment checklist are missing.
Delivery-ready projects can be converted into ClientOps records.
Monthly review and report notes exist with local report generation.
Upgrade opportunities can create local sales follow-up drafts.

client_journey.primary_gap: The journey works as a local private-beta rehearsal path, but lacks production persistence, auth, launch acceptance, and paid-client operating policy.

website_studio_analysis.template_browse: Working for public browse/search/filter and one concrete detail preview.
website_studio_analysis.template_marketplace: Partial; dataset exists and browse UI works, but not every template slug/detail path is implemented and compare/start links are not implemented routes.
website_studio_analysis.brand_kit: Partial; internal brand profile and Development Library brand engine exist, but no public/client brand configuration step is connected to template selection.
website_studio_analysis.template_detail: Partial; Floral Boutique preview exists, recommended templates route back to browse, dynamic template detail coverage is missing.
website_studio_analysis.website_generation_flow: Missing; /studio/start is linked from preview CTAs but not routed in shf-next App.tsx, and no generated site packet path was found.
website_studio_analysis.build_packet_connection: Partial; Development Library can generate build packets, but template selection does not feed it directly.
website_studio_analysis.client_delivery_connection: Partial; QA and ClientOps delivery path exists, but Website Studio output does not enter delivery as a concrete project artifact.
exact_missing_pieces: Persist selected template as project/template context.
Implement or redirect /studio/start to an existing safe intake step.
Connect brand configuration to selected template.
Generate a site packet or build packet from selected template plus brand kit.
Route generated packet into QA/Delivery or ClientOps handoff.
Define beta labels for unavailable marketplace actions like compare/start if they remain out of scope.

launch_blockers: No production auth/session enforcement for paid-client launch.
Core SHS lifecycle uses localStorage/local demo data rather than durable production persistence.
Website Studio cannot complete Select Template -> Configure Brand -> Generate Site Packet -> Deliver Site.
/studio/start and marketplace compare/start actions are not implemented as complete launch paths.
Build Packet Generator output is not yet a signed/exportable delivery artifact.
Launch acceptance/signoff checklist is missing between QA Delivery Ready and ClientOps conversion.
ClientOps monthly report output is local-record-only and needs paid-client delivery/approval policy.
Operator runbooks are missing for private beta and paid launch.
Route/browser smoke checklist is not yet captured for every critical SHS path.
Public/private copy and data leakage scan is still required before paid launch.

highest_roi_tasks.task: Run and document one complete SHS client journey rehearsal from lead to upgrade opportunity.
Create private-beta operator runbook and route smoke checklist.
Close Website Studio /studio/start gap with a launch-safe intake or implemented next step.
Persist selected template and brand configuration as build-packet context.
Turn build packet output into an exportable/approvable artifact.
Define QA Delivery Ready -> Launch -> ClientOps acceptance checklist.
Decide paid-client auth/persistence constraints and write the beta limitation policy.
Finalize ClientOps monthly report approval and delivery rules.
Run public/private language and data leakage scan across public SHS/WebMaker routes.
Normalize template dataset/detail coverage so browse cards do not lead to dead or fallback routes.

recommended_build_order: 1. Private-beta operator runbook and route smoke checklist
2. End-to-end SHS client journey rehearsal using current local workflow
3. QA Delivery Ready -> Launch -> ClientOps acceptance checklist
4. Website Studio /studio/start decision and safe next-step implementation plan
5. Template selection + brand kit persistence into build-packet context
7. ClientOps monthly report delivery and approval policy
launch_recommendation: Do not declare SHS paid-client launch-ready yet. Proceed to private beta only after the top private-beta runbook, smoke, and end-to-end rehearsal tasks are completed. Treat Website Studio generation and paid-client auth/persistence as the highest-risk paid-launch gaps.
